response:
- Q3 scope must be finalized Friday for Sara’s executive review on Monday.

- Reconciliation revamp is the Q3 anchor initiative. The current engine struggles with multi-currency batches; reconciliation support tickets are up 40% QoQ, with three incidents this quarter. Building internally is preferred over vendors due to cost, tax-code limitations, and remaining integration effort.

- Engineering estimates the reconciliation rewrite at six engineer-weeks, including FX-rounding migration. It requires two weeks of Karim’s Platform support for ledger integration.

- Mobile receipt capture will ship as v1 without bulk-select. User testing supported making the OCR confidence indicator more prominent; bulk-select is a fast-follow roadmap item.

- Vendor payout SLA target is 48 hours from invoice approval. Current p95 is 71 hours. Potential path: reduce ACH batching from every 12 hours to every four hours and add a second approver for the West Coast shift. Engineering estimates about half a sprint plus SRE approval; increased monitoring is the main tradeoff.

- Audit-log retention work is deferred to Q4 with Legal confirmation. The internal admin-tool refresh remains with the intern team, with no scope changes.

- Engineering burnout from bug bashes needs attention; Marcus will propose a rotating on-call structure.

Next steps:

- Marcus: confirm Karim’s availability with his manager this week; prepare ACH batching tradeoff analysis with Jenna and obtain SRE input; propose rotating on-call structure by Aug. 31.
- Dan: update mobile receipt-capture specs by Wednesday.
- Jenna: partner with Marcus on the ACH/SLA analysis.
- Priya: circulate the Q3 scope draft Thursday morning for review before Friday’s lock.
- Sara: present the finalized scope at Monday’s executive review.
